newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 25.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Japanese drug maker Green Cross Corp will be absorbed by Yoshitomi Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd in October.
-- U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright asks China to smoothly handle the defection of a senior North Korean official.
-- The government, the ruling Liberal Democratic Party and its allies agree on allowing the formation of holding companies with assets of up to 15 trillion yen.
-- The ruling Liberal Democratic Party and its allies are considering limiting holding companies' assets to up to 20 trillion yen.
-- Albright calls for stronger U.S. ties with China.
-- The Peruvian government and rebels hold fifth round of talks on hostage crisis.
-- U.S. and China agree to hold meeting to restrict the spread of nuclear technology.
